name: gopassui-adm
description: Administrative commands for gopassui - change UI password, manage remote deployment

commands.description: Change the gopassui basic authentication password on dk1

baseArgs: ssh dk1@92.113.145.178 "sudo sed -i 's/BASIC_AUTH_PASS=.*/BASIC_AUTH_PASS=$1/' /etc/systemd/system/gopassui.service && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart gopassui && echo 'Password changed successfully'"
adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Ensure SSH access to dk1 is configured

commands.description: Generate a random password and set it for gopassui authentication

baseArgs: NEW_PASS=$(openssl rand -base64 16 | tr -d '=+/' | cut -c1-16) && ssh dk1@92.113.145.178 "sudo sed -i \"s/BASIC_AUTH_PASS=.*/BASIC_AUTH_PASS=$NEW_PASS/\" /etc/systemd/system/gopassui.service && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart gopassui" && echo "Password changed to: $NEW_PASS"
adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Ensure SSH access to dk1 is configured

commands.description: Show the current gopassui authentication password

baseArgs: ssh dk1@92.113.145.178 'sudo systemctl show gopassui.service | grep BASIC_AUTH_PASS'
adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Ensure SSH access to dk1 is configured
